content: Modeling sensationalism is also related to modeling emotion. Emotion has been well investigated in both word levelBIBREF28, BIBREF29 and sentence levelBIBREF30, BIBREF31, BIBREF32, BIBREF33, BIBREF34. It has also been considered an important factor in engaging interactive systemsBIBREF35, BIBREF36, BIBREF37. Although we observe that sensational headlines contain emotion, it is still not clear which emotion and how emotions will influence the sensationalism.
